reading: The sketch lays out a zine/magazine front page as a ruled 8-cell grid (gray wireframe), with a wavy top band read as a heading, and each cell's content fully specified by typed notes: a pull-quote with a sideways "LOUD", a blue/yellow duotone tile, a tracklist, a bold quote, credits, a price callout ("£4" / "post free in the UK"), and a tilted "SOLD OUT SOON" badge stamped across the grid line.
